treatment.logline: A street-food vendor returns a stranger's phone and, for one rainy minute, the two of them forget their worlds.
treatment.approach: Wide for the world, long lenses for intimacy; a still camera except where a thing falls or someone runs.

colour_script.palette: cool grey-teal with the tea's warmth
colour_script.light: Flat, heavy-overcast monsoon daylight, soft and cool, wet surfaces catching the glow of shop fronts and headlights

treatment.geography: Kasun's stall is screen left; the road and her car are screen right; she crosses toward him and leaves to the right.
treatment.key_image: Anudi small in the rain, walking away, Kasun still behind his stall.
advice: The scene is ~60 s in the cut; the bin is far larger by design.

sequences.title: The world
sequences.purpose: Establish the rain, the stall and the other world

sequences.title: The meeting
sequences.purpose: A dropped phone becomes a first conversation

sequences.title: The call
sequences.purpose: The father's call closes the moment; she leaves

moments.what: Kasun works his stall in the monsoon
moments.cut_uses: the wide master, then Kasun close: the place first, the ambition second

moments.what: She drops her phone; Kasun picks it up and runs

moments.what: He calls after her; she turns and thanks him

moments.what: She asks; he answers with his story
moments.cut_uses: the two-shot as the master, Anudi's face as she listens

editor_notes: Masters (setups B, H, K, P, U, V, G) are the cut; the Q and S singles and the insert are the only alternates: the bin is held to the given length plus 50%.
Avoided: a dolly zoom on the phone call (Veo is unreliable); the father is never shown; a speed ramp on the run is post only.
Dialogue plays under the chosen audio: only the masters and the speakers' singles perform lines.
